C901.text: Luhya reinforcement training findings and acceptance record · Tenant confidential

C902.text: The Luhya reinforcement of audio language model v2 was refused against its signed acceptance. The held-out measure lwg was not measured, and the speaker probe on the served output was at chance. The record covers this retained run only.

C903.text: Seven strata are listed, each with a recorded floor of {F012}% and an abstention rate of {F015}%, but no score. The record shows what was intended for each stratum and nothing about what the model achieved.

C904.text: The recommendation is to measure before improving. Score all seven strata on held-out material, find out why abstention was total, and clarify the speaker probe requirement. Retain the artefact on its host and judge any later change on fresh sealed material.

C905.text: The Luhya reinforcement was refused, and the record holds no per-stratum score to improve from

C906.text: A reinforcement run for audio language model v2 was trained, signed and retained with its acceptance record. Seven strata are on the record: Ekegusii, Kikamba, Gikuyu, Kalenjin, Dholuo, Luhya and Kiswahili. Each carries a recorded floor of {F012}%.

C907.text: Acceptance refused the run. The held-out measure lwg was not measured, and the speaker probe on the served output was at chance. Every stratum shows no score and an abstention rate of {F015}%. A floor is a recipe setting, not performance.

C908.text: Which model or dataset improvement should the owner pursue next, given what was and was not measured?

C909.text: Measure before changing anything. Run a held-out evaluation that scores all seven strata against their floors, and settle what the speaker probe result means for acceptance. Keep the artefact, digest beginning {F011}, on its host. Judge any later recipe change on fresh sealed material.

C911.text: Acceptance refused the run, and all seven strata show no measured score

C912.text: Refusal rests on two grounds: lwg was not measured on the held-out set, and the speaker probe on the served output was at chance.

C913.text: Seven strata are listed, each with a recorded floor of {F012}%: Ekegusii, Kikamba, Gikuyu, Kalenjin, Dholuo, Luhya and Kiswahili.

C914.text: Every stratum shows no score and an abstention rate of {F015}%, so none can be called above or below its floor.

C915.text: The acceptance record gives two grounds for refusal: lwg was not measured on the held-out set, and the speaker probe on the served output was at chance. The record does not interpret the probe result further, so this paper does not either.

C916.text: The strata are Ekegusii, Kikamba, Gikuyu, Kalenjin, Dholuo, Luhya and Kiswahili, each with a recorded floor of {F012}%. Each also shows an abstention rate of {F015}% and no score. Abstention is not accuracy, and a floor is a recipe setting rather than a measurement, so no stratum can be called above or below its floor.

C924.text: Measure all seven strata first, then settle the speaker probe, before any retraining

C925.text: First, score each of the seven strata on held-out material against its {F012}% floor. This closes the unmeasured lwg ground.

C926.text: Second, find out why abstention was {F015}% everywhere: model behaviour, scoring gap or serving fault. Change no recipe until this is known.

C927.text: Third, ask reviewers what a speaker probe at chance means under the signed acceptance.

C928.text: Fourth, keep the artefact, digest beginning {F011}, on its host. Judge later changes on fresh sealed material.

C929.text: First, run a held-out evaluation scoring each of the seven strata against its {F012}% floor. This closes the unmeasured lwg ground and gives the owner the per-stratum view the decision needs.

C930.text: Second, establish why abstention was {F015}% everywhere, and ask the reviewers what the speaker probe at chance must mean under the signed acceptance. Neither question should be answered by assumption. Until they are, a recipe change would be guesswork, because the record shows no stratum where the model fell short.

C931.text: Third, keep the artefact, digest beginning {F011}, on its host. Judge any later recipe change on fresh, independently labelled and sealed material.

C932.text: The record cannot support claims beyond the seven strata or independent acceptance

C933.text: Performance outside the measured strata is not established. An independently designed evaluation would close this.

C934.text: Independent final acceptance is unavailable because these results have been inspected. Fresh, independently labelled and sealed material would close it.

C935.text: Lineage from objective to production is incomplete: no new production plan links to this historical run. Compile an evidence-linked objective; never backdate.

C936.text: Per-stratum strengths and weaknesses are unknown, given {F015}% abstention and no scores.

C937.text: The run says nothing about general cognition or performance outside the seven strata. An independently designed evaluation would be needed to say more.

C938.text: Independent final acceptance is not available once further recipe selection has been informed by results that have been inspected. Fresh, independently labelled and sealed final material would restore it.

C939.text: No new production plan is linked to this historical run, so objective-to-production lineage is incomplete. It should be closed by an explicitly compiled, evidence-linked objective, never by a backdated assumption.
